Marissa / Karthik,

Forwarding Nimbus's CSV (attached to original thread) — they're asking for a one-time settlement/invoice for retroactive usage Mar–May. Quick context: they are on a Dedicated plan with a monthly committed capacity; spikes in March and April pushed them over the threshold. They want a single-line invoice to attach to a PO.

Options I'm proposing:
1) One-time backcharge = total overage tokens * published overage rate (no discount). Pros: clean and fast.
2) Discounted settlement = apply a 15% goodwill discount to the overage (one-time charge). Pros: helps AM retain goodwill during expansion talks.
3) Partial credit + deferred true-up: apply credit for May spike only and invoice Mar/Apr overage. Complicates procurement.

Constraints: they need an invoice by next Friday (2026-05-28), and procurement requires a 60-day net term by default — we can offer 30 days if Finance agrees.

Can you weigh in on what we can approve autonomously vs what needs Finance review? If we can approve up to 20% discount, I can finalize with Nimbus today.

Thanks,
Sooy

- Apply 15% discount => $28,500 (round to nearest 100)
- Issue single invoice and a short addendum that states this is a one-time settlement for Mar–May 2026 overage; no change to base contract.

I'll draft the addendum and attach it as draft_addendum_Nimbus_May2026.pdf. If Finance signs off on 30-day NET, we can send to Olivia with the invoice_ NIMBUS_202605.pdf.
